serverInfo.name: forms-on-fire-mcp
serverInfo.title: Forms On Fire MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Forms On Fire, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many inspection forms were submitted this week, and by whom?"; "Show the answers of the latest 'Site Safety Check' entries."; "Which tasks assigned to Maria are still open?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Forms On Fire data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run formsonfire_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run formsonfire_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run formsonfire_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. formsonfire_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: formsonfire_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the forms (screens) in the organization with id, name, version and status. Use a form id with formsonfire_get_form or formsonfire_search_entries. GET /screen/form/search.

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page_no.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_form
tools.title: Get form definition
tools.description: One form's definition: name, version, status and its fields (names and types, which are the names to use for prefilled answers). Give the form's id (GUID) or its external id. GET /screen/form.

tools.name: formsonfire_search_entries
tools.title: Search form entries
tools.description: Search submitted form entries (the completed forms your team sent in): who filled them, when, where (GPS) and every answer. Filter by form id or external id, version and a date range (by received time, or complete time via order_by). Returns the page of Entries with TotalRows. GET /formentry/search.

form_id.description: Only entries of this form (id, GUID).

form_external_id.description: Only entries of the form with this external id.

form_version.description: Form version; 0 or omitted = the latest published version, -1 = all versions.

answer_format.description: How form answers are shaped: Flat (one value per field, easiest to read), Rich (typed values) or Raw (as stored). Default: the vendor's default.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return (works with answer_format Flat).

order_by.description: Sort and date-filter by ReceivedTime (default) or CompleteTime (when the form was completed on the device).

media_as_url.description: Return photos/signatures as URLs instead of embedded data.

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page_no.

tools.name: formsonfire_search_tasks
tools.title: Search tasks
tools.description: Search tasks (jobs assigned to field workers, each with one or more activities such as filling out a form): status, assignee, due time, activities and history. Filter by assignee, status, name, task template and date range. Returns the page of Tasks with TotalRows. GET /task/search.

user_email.description: Only tasks of the user with this email.

user_external_id.description: Only tasks of the user with this external id.

template_id.description: Only tasks created from this task template id.

retrieve_entries.description: Also return the form entries completed by the task's activities.

answer_format.description: How form answers are shaped: Flat (one value per field, easiest to read), Rich (typed values) or Raw (as stored). Default: the vendor's default.

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page_no.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by its id (GUID), with activities and history. GET /task.

retrieve_entries.description: Also return the form entries completed by the task's activities.

answer_format.description: How form answers are shaped: Flat (one value per field, easiest to read), Rich (typed values) or Raw (as stored). Default: the vendor's default.

tools.name: formsonfire_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task for a field worker with one form to fill out, optionally with prefilled answers. By default it remains a draft; send_immediate=true sends it and notifies the worker. Identify the worker by email, user id or external id (list_users). The form is identified by its external id (formsonfire_get_form shows field names for the prefilled answers). Requires confirm=true and a due time. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two tasks. POST /task.

user_email.description: Email of the worker (user) the task is assigned to.

user_id.description: Id (GUID) of the worker the task is assigned to.

user_external_id.description: External id of the worker the task is assigned to.

name.description: Task name shown on the device, e.g. 'Site inspection - Acme'.

icon.description: Task icon name (vendor icon list), e.g. Clock.

start_by.description: When the task should be started (ISO 8601 UTC).

additional_info.description: Free-text instructions shown with the task.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved creating the task and any requested notification.

send_immediate.description: Notify the worker right away (vendor default applies when omitted).

form_external_id.description: External id of the form the worker has to fill out.

instruction.description: Instruction shown for this form activity.

answers.description: Prefilled answers: field data name and value.

name.description: The field's data name in the form.

tools.name: formsonfire_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the organization's users (field workers and admins): name, email, status, groups, website role and last activity. Passwords and keys are never returned. GET /user/search.

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page_no.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: One user by id (GUID): name, status, groups, folders, role and registered devices. GET /user.

tools.name: formsonfire_list_groups
tools.title: List user groups
tools.description: List user groups with their id, name and member user ids. Filter by name or external id. Returns UserGroups with TotalRows. GET /usergroup/search.

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page_no.

tools.name: formsonfire_list_data_sources
tools.title: List data sources
tools.description: List the data sources (lookup tables that feed dropdowns and prefill in forms, such as customers, sites or products): id, external id, name and row count. Use formsonfire_get_data_source for the rows. GET /datasource/search.

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page_no.

tools.name: formsonfire_get_data_source
tools.title: Get data source
tools.description: One data source by id (GUID) or external id: its column headers, TotalRows and (with return_rows) a page of rows. Rows are only returned when return_rows is true; page through them with page_no. GET /datasource.

return_rows.description: Also return the rows (default false: headers and total only).

page_no.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page_no.
